integrity: One explicit geometric length-spectrum theorem with a deductive proof and finite exact-arithmetic reproducibility checks. Publication priority cannot be certified from a finite search.
scientific_limitations: Covers fixed-by-iterate nonhyperbolic center intervals on the smooth two-sided core only; not boundary-periodic points or exact least-period counts. title: Exact neutral-periodic fiber length spectrum for the heterochaos baker maps
